title: PowerToys does not start automatically on boot

judgment.rationale: The reproduction is clear and current related work exists, but the rejected diagnostics do not reveal whether startup registration or process launch fails.
evidence: Author supplied report archives, but automated triage rejected them as oversized.
Open #48567 is a current related startup issue; closed #43395 is historical evidence only.
judgment.recommended_action: Request Task Scheduler result and a fresh bounded report before deduplicating or designing a fix.

fix_assessment.rationale: The correct fix owner and failure boundary are not established from the current public evidence.

issue_context.summary: A Windows 11 25H2 user reports that Run at startup is enabled but PowerToys does not start after reboot; multiple report ZIP attachments were supplied, while automated triage rejected the archive as oversized.
known_information: PowerToys 0.101.2362 Stable is reported from GitHub installation.
Windows 11 25H2, system installation, running as administrator, and Simplified Chinese are specified.
The reproduction enables General > Run at startup and restarts the PC.
The reporter supplied multiple PowerToysReport ZIP links and later said the report was added.
Open related issue #48567 is titled Run at Startup; #43395 is closed and describes a similar login-autostart failure.
inferences: The failure may involve the startup task, elevated/system install identity, or a localized/25H2 task-registration boundary.
The current public record does not show whether the scheduled task exists, runs, or exits immediately.
issue_context.analysis: The symptom is reproducible and related work exists, but task state and a usable diagnostic are needed before choosing between duplicate routing and a startup-registration fix.
initial_investigation: Current issue activity includes author-provided reports after automated triage.
Search found open #48567 as a stronger current startup tracker than closed #43395.
No code change should be duplicated until #48567 and task registration state are compared.

information_gaps.information: Startup-task state after enabling Run at startup: task name, run-as identity, last-run result, and whether PowerToys starts then exits.
information_gaps.why_needed: Distinguishes registration, privilege, localization, and process-start failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: After reboot, inspect Task Scheduler and submit `/bugreport` immediately; include the task Last Run Result and whether the PowerToys process briefly appears.

actions.label: Request startup task result
actions.note: Ask for the exact scheduled-task outcome and a usable report.

comment.body: The report supplies a clear reproduction and the important environment details (0.101.2362, Windows 11 25H2, system installation, administrator run, Simplified Chinese). Because the submitted archives were rejected as oversized, please enable Run at startup, reboot once, and immediately submit `/bugreport`; also report whether the PowerToys process appears briefly and provide the Task Scheduler entry’s Last Run Result and Run As identity. This distinguishes a missing task registration from a task that starts and exits or cannot cross the elevation boundary, and it will show whether the open related tracker #48567 is the correct owner.
